title: Equivalent fractions
info: Equivalent fractions look different but name the same amount.
1/2 and 2/4 are equivalent. You can multiply the top and bottom by the same number.

questions.explain: 2/4 is two parts out of four, the same as one half.

questions.q: What do you do to make an equivalent fraction?
options: Multiply top and bottom by the same number

questions.q: Type a fraction equal to 1/2. Use a slash, like 2/4.
